title: GenericHubPlugin
description: Just a Generic Hub Plugin for your server!
body:
This is just a plugin I made for fun.
It's a generic hub plugin, nothing special.

**Features:**
- Able to change Join Message, Title and Sound!
- Able to change Left Message and Sound
- Able to change Scoreboard and Tablist
- Able to change chatformat
- Support PlaceholderAPI
